images.scene: A Brazilian small-shop owner in a work apron standing behind the long wooden counter of his modest mid-century shop, leaning forward with both hands planted firmly on the countertop, chin slightly raised, the skeptical earnest expression of a man explaining why his case is special, shelves of plain goods behind him, his figure and the counter filling the bottom third of the frame. No lettering anywhere. The space above is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

An antique two-pan balance scale in perfect equilibrium standing on a worn wooden market table: a small heap of ripe tomatoes piled on one pan, a single large old-fashioned iron door key resting on the other pan, both pans exactly level, still-life, no people, the scale filling the bottom third of the frame and bleeding off the bottom edge. No lettering anywhere. The space above is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A mid-century Brazilian street scene: on the left a wooden market stall loaded with tomatoes, the vendor in an apron handing a paper bag to a customer in animated conversation; on the right, beside the stall, the glass door of a small storefront office where a man in a modest suit talks calmly with a couple, the office window holding only small blank white cards with no writing. Two different sellers, two different conversations, one continuous sidewalk. The people and stalls filling the bottom third of the frame. No lettering anywhere. The space above is bright, washed out, hazy and empty.

Seen from behind, a shop owner standing at the wooden railing of a small interior mezzanine of his own shop, hands resting on the rail, looking down over the shop floor below with its long counter, orderly shelves and a clerk attending a customer, his dark silhouette and the railing kept low in the frame. No lettering anywhere. The space above is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A workshop bench seen at a slight angle: clean metal gears of different sizes laid out in a neat row, a wooden clipboard holding blank ruled sheets, a fountain pen and hand tools aligned in perfect order, a small machine halfway assembled at one end of the bench, still-life, no people, the bench filling the bottom third of the frame and bleeding off the bottom edge. All papers are blank with no legible text. The space above is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A close view of a firm handshake between two men sealing a deal over a plain wooden counter, worn shirt cuffs and modest jacket sleeves, no faces visible, the hands and counter filling the bottom third of the frame and bleeding off the bottom edge. No lettering anywhere. The space above is bright, washed out, hazy and empty.

Early morning at a small mid-century Brazilian corner shop: a patient line of customers waiting on the sidewalk as the owner opens the front door, awning shadows, baskets in hands, a sense of steady constant daily movement, the queue and doorway filling the bottom third of the frame. No lettering anywhere. The space above is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

An old machine pushed into the corner of a storeroom, completely covered by a heavy dusty canvas tarp, its mechanical shape only suggested under the cloth, dust on the wooden floor around it, still-life, no people, the covered machine filling the bottom third of the frame. No lettering anywhere. The space above is pale, hazy and empty.

A weary salesman alone behind the crowded counter of a small shop at closing time, sleeves rolled up, tie loosened, wiping his forehead with the back of his hand, surrounded by stacked goods and piled papers on the counter, visibly holding the whole shop's movement in his own two hands, his figure and the counter filling the bottom third of the frame. All papers are blank with no legible text. No lettering anywhere. The space above is pale, hazy and empty.

A close view of interlocked metal gears of an antique machine meshing precisely, teeth engaged, a clean oiled mechanism in motion, still-life, no people, the gears filling the bottom third of the frame and bleeding off the bottom edge. No lettering anywhere. The space above is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A confident Brazilian shop owner in a buttoned work shirt and apron standing with arms crossed in the open doorway of his tidy shop in bright morning light, a slight assured smile, photographed from farther away so his figure appears SMALL, his whole figure and the doorway compressed into the LOWEST QUARTER of the frame, his head far below the vertical midpoint of the image. Above him rises a vast tall blank pale wall taking up the entire upper three quarters of the image, bright, hazy and empty, fading to near-white at the top.
